== Verdict ==
  Target segment CONFIRMED.
    Scrambling what is said costs whole nats, so the markers, the token
    offset, the loss mask and the shift are the ones this checkpoint
    continues. This is the half that would waste the compute if wrong.
  Reference and speaker NOT CONFIRMED.
    role_swapped: -0.026 nats over correct (needs >= 0.2)
    Pairing is sound (0.65 cosine), so the references are
    the right speaker and there was something real to corrupt. Two
    readings remain and this test cannot separate them: either our
    reference layout is not the trained one, or the checkpoint is
    near-indifferent to identity conditioning under teacher forcing.
    The second is plausible -- each audio token is mostly
    predictable from the ones before it, and the `no_reference` row
    above says what the entire reference prefix is worth. Note also
    that role_swapped is not a pure corruption: its layout is what a
    *second segment* of a multi-segment sample looks like, which
    `final_seg` existing at all implies the checkpoint saw.
    What this blocks: claiming the reference layout is right. Training
    the target segment is still on solid ground, and the training plan
    already calls for reference dropout -- so train with it, and settle
    the reference layout by generating from both and scoring speaker
    similarity, which this metric cannot see.
  no_reference is diagnostic: inference supports dropping the reference and the
  training plan calls for doing so on some examples, so a small gap is expected.
